name: cascade-calendar
description: A calendar view for Cascade Bicycle Club free group rides.

scripts.build: node scripts/build.js && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist --filename cascade-calendar-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.check: npm run build && node --check extension/content.js && node --check scripts/build.js && node --check dist/cascade-calendar.user.js && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --warnings-as-errors
